captions.detailed: An ultra-wide rectilinear prime lens featuring a bulging matte-black front housing and a narrower cylindrical rear barrel. It is equipped with a bulging, blue-tinted front glass element and a silver-grey rear mount. The assembly includes a wide focus ring located near the front and a narrower aperture ring closer to the rear, both of which rotate independently around the central axis of the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate an ultra-wide rectilinear prime camera lens with a bulging front housing, a narrower rear barrel, a blue-tinted front glass element, and a grey rear mount. Include a wide focus ring near the front and a narrower aperture ring near the rear, both configured with continuous revolute joints for independent rotation around the lens axis.
captions.factory: The lens is constructed by defining three main parts: a base body, a focus ring, and an aperture ring. The base body is created using a series of revolved 2D sketches to form the main outer chassis profile, the bulging front element housing, the inner cavities, and the spherical front glass element. The focus ring and aperture rings are modeled as separate concentric cylinders with outer ridges. Two continuous revolute joints are then defined along the central Z-axis to connect the focus ring and the aperture ring to the main base body.
